title: Feature Request:  Option to allow the Emergency Messages feature to only trigger when hypo
body: I love the Emergency Messages option but would like to be able to switch it to only send messages when hypo is triggered.  I have my low alarm set to 80 so that gets triggered quite a bit and my wife is pretty numb to all of that at this point... but if she only get them for hypos, it would be more effective as a true alarm/concern thing.

comments.body:
@gitanO0 Hi,
Is this still a problem?

What happens if you set the value of your Low alarm to what you consider to be your hypo level?  Then, call your low level something else, like LessLow.  
Would it not then send the message only when you get the Low alarm, which is your hypo now?
But, when you are at your low level, which is now called LessLow, it should not send the message.
